title: Shared assets manifest
description: Catalog read by OpenNMS UI plugins. Jetty serves this directory with directory listing disabled, so plugins cannot discover files on their own; this file is how they learn what exists.

revision.description: Bump whenever an existing file changes. Plugins append ?rev=<revision> to every URL, so a new revision bypasses the browser's 1-hour cache.

nodeIconRules.description: Evaluated top to bottom; the first rule whose conditions all match wins.

categories.description: Any of these surveillance category names (case-insensitive).

sysObjectIdPrefixes.description: sysObjectID starts with one of these OIDs, on an arc boundary.

labelPattern.description: JavaScript regular expression, tested case-insensitively against the node label.

defaultIcon.description: Icon key used when no rule matches.

path.description: Path relative to the shared-assets root. No leading slash, no . or .. segments.
